# Subadevan C

> Offensive security researcher (web & API security) and final-year B.E. Computer Science and Engineering (Cybersecurity) student at Jerusalem College of Engineering, Chennai, India. Co-founder of the CTF team Flaggers United. Portfolio: https://subadevan.tech

## Security research
- Vercel (Flags SDK, open source): stateful regular-expression flaw that leaked state across evaluations. $400 bounty, Sep 2026.
- Instacart: API security vulnerability. $250 bounty, 2026.
- Sony: DOM-based XSS and broken access control via its VDP on HackerOne. Both remediated, 2026.
- ZKTeco: authentication bypass. INR 18,000 reward.
- Responsible disclosures and halls of fame: JPMorgan Chase, World Health Organization, UNESCO, Porsche.

## Competitions
- 21 top-3 competition finishes across CTF, Boot2Root and bug bounty events, including 1st at the ISACA Trivandrum Chapter CTF 2026 (team, ₹25,000).
- Flaggers United on CTFtime: https://ctftime.org/team/356365

## Experience and community
- DevSecOps Intern, TechForce Services (Jun–Jul 2025): least-privilege IAM, network hardening, Terraform and CI/CD on AWS and GCP.
- President, Cyber Nexus Club, JCE (Aug 2025 – Aug 2026); organised DOOMS CTF 2026 and SPYIREX CTF 2026.
